decisions.reason: As a large bulk container close to the firm's established offer, it builds directly on existing design and manufacturing knowledge, giving high absorptive capacity to learn from early results and improve the product.

The bulk-container valve builds on established engineering and product knowledge, and its dedicated website page indicates active market learning, so the firm can assimilate feedback and refine it, making a near-term drop unlikely.

The used packaging take-back service leverages the firm's rental and pooling capabilities but is a less core service innovation with only a website mention, so while it remains aligned with the firm's sustainability direction, there is moderate risk it may be dropped within a year.
